title: Bitcoin Weigh-In Daily Commodity Price Dataset
description:
Daily commodity prices denominated in Bitcoin, 2013-present. Raw USD closes for BTC, gold, silver, platinum, copper, Brent crude, wheat, and coffee, US weekly retail gasoline and diesel prices, plus derived per-BTC values and a deterministically computed BTC circulating supply.

One row per calendar day from 2013-01-02, updated daily. The data files are in static/data/v1.1.0/ of this archive (CSV, JSON, NDJSON and Parquet, with schema.json, CITATION.cff, CHANGELOG.md and SHA256SUMS); the rest of the archive is the code that builds and publishes them. Sources, column definitions and the forward-fill rules are documented at bitcoinweighin.com/data and bitcoinweighin.com/methodology.
